overview: In her time on LA Ink, fans have watched Kat go from celebrated tattoo artist to fully developed entrepreneur. In the past year, Kat launched a successful line of cosmetics at Sephora and had her book hit The New York Time's Best Sellers List. As her profile has risen, so has the shop's business - and the pressure to succeed. All of this leads into a new season that finds Kat facing familiar challenges, but quickly explodes with a level of drama and action never seen before. Kat Von D, known for her no-nonsense, tell-it-like-it-is demeanor has made an indelible mark on the tattoo industry. Her success in a male dominated field is inspiring, but it comes with its share of stress. While Kat is focused on expanding her product line and writing a new book, the shop faces unexpected - and unwelcome - changes. The introduction of new shop manager, Aubry Fisher, (from Rock of Love fame) is just one example. Playing by her own rules, Kat lives a fast-paced, rebel lifestyle. Hers is a life of freedom: she sets her own schedule, picks her clients, sleeps late,and parties all night. For her shop to be a continued success, Kat will need to learn how to balance her lifestyle and her business while managing a colorful staff of renowned artists. LA Ink offers a rare glimpse into an LA that is seldom seen, through the eyes of a true insider.

In the end, they put a stop to a deadly wolf-poison experiment that threatened the lives of Ningcheng's residents, brought down the mastermind behind the criminal underworld, saved the people of Ningcheng, and upheld their faith and devotion to their country.

However, Svetlana secretly takes guardianship of Sonya and announces that the girl will now live with her permanently. Katya urgently comes to Moscow to help her sister, who is finding it increasingly difficult to get along with the domineering Svetlana. To have any chance of challenging her aunt's guardianship, she enters into a фиктивный marriage with Stepan — this way, she obtains a residence permit and the prospect of obtaining Russian citizenship.

After the Victory, it disappeared without a trace.
title: Янтарная комната

overview: In January 1993, Joseph Brodsky appeared on Russian television for the first and last time. This happened in the city he loved so much: "If reincarnation exists, I would like to live my next life in Venice – to be a cat there, or anything else, but definitely in Venice." It was in this city that the poet was buried, on the Island of the Dead, in the San Michele cemetery, next to Stravinsky and Diaghilev, who, like him, were exiles who brought glory to Russia throughout the world. The cycle does not contain any voice‑over text. This is Brodsky's monologue, his reflections in the first person, a kind of philosophical essay "about the world, the beloved homeland, and about himself." With each passing year, with each passing day, his thoughts and words acquire an ever deeper and more piercing meaning, as if time is trying to catch up with the poet. Authors: Alexey Shishov, Elena Yakovich.
title: Иосиф Бродский. Возвращение

overview: Sita is a journalist who decides to infiltrate a high-end prostitution club to investigate the mystery of her sister Tania's death. Her investigation leads her to meet Arian, a man who runs an exclusive business with a network of elite clients. The deeper Sita digs, the more secrets she uncovers. What began as a mere object of investigation turns into a dangerous game involving powerful people, money, and conflicting interests. To achieve her goals, Sita begins to manipulate Arian's feelings. However, as their relationship becomes more complicated, the lines between disguise and reality begin to blur. Amidst this game of intrigue, major questions arise: who is truly in control of the situation, and who is trapped within it.

overview: A story about two sisters who lost their parents six years ago and, due to their age and circumstances, were unable to maintain a warm atmosphere and mutual understanding in their home. But after going through a series of harsh trials, it is the sense of family and home that will awaken their sisterly love and mutual affection. This is a story about the importance of family in anyone's life, about the wisdom of the older generation and the trust of the younger ones, about the moral purity of girls and the power of love, and about faith in the changes that await the characters.

overview: The main character of the series is the geologist Yasha Teplyakov. After many years of a nomadic life, he returns to Kulakovo to start over: to build a house, find a job, and finally find personal happiness. His first love, Svetlana, lives there. Rumour has it that she is not married and is raising her son alone, so Yasha hopes that fate will give them another chance. His childhood friends welcome Yasha like family. Despite their different personalities, they are always ready to support their friend and sincerely believe: "You're a good guy, everything will work out for you." Yasha's world is built on simple but firm principles: the strong should not harm the weak, lying is unacceptable, and those who find themselves in trouble must be helped. His garage, converted into an auto repair shop, becomes a place where people go when they have no one else to turn to. Over time, Yasha becomes an unofficial helper to the local police. For the head of the Kulakovsky police department, Lieutenant Colonel Shepelev, an old friend of Yasha's late father, such a person is both a boon and a source of…

overview: On the first day of their divorce cooling-off period, Lu Zhengdong, Lin Banxia's estranged husband, suddenly experiences a bizarre glitch —his body begins uncontrollably switching between his adult and teenage forms. Forced into this absurd situation, Lin Banxia finds herself drawn into an unexpected chapter of their troubled relationship. As the strange phenomenon continues, the two gradually let down the emotional defenses they have built around themselves. Beneath their strained marriage and unresolved conflicts lie two wounded hearts, each carrying pain they have never truly confronted. Through this unexpected journey, Lu Zhengdong and Lin Banxia slowly rediscover the sincerity and affection that once brought them together. As they learn to face their past wounds and understand each other, they begin to heal and redeem one another through genuine love. When the divorce cooling-off period finally ends, they are given one last chance to choose their future. Having shed their pretenses and rediscovered the love they once lost, Lu Zhengdong and Lin Banxia choose not to part ways, but to renew their marriage vows and begin their relationship anew.

overview: The pink sand beaches of Bermuda, the chalk cliffs of Southern England, the rolling hills of the South-East, the granite cliffs, snowy mountains, high and lowlands of the Scottish isles: the world's islands have an incredibly diverse array of stunning landscapes and fascinating cultures thriving in them. Each episode of this sublime series features a different island country around the world, showcasing their natural beauty and their unique peoples and traditions. Parts of the story are told from a birds eye perspective, which presents the landscapes from a new and unique vantage point: We fly over spiky rock needles, discover secluded bays and gigantic bird colonies, buffeted by the sea. Every now and then the camera ‘discovers' a protagonist below, introducing us to a local who invites us into their way of life. Whether its time for tea in the watch house of St. Mary, Bermuda Day parade in Hamilton, or time for treasure hunting on St. Kilda, this is your chance to explore the world's tiniest and most remote communities.
